page.overview:
Who is Asenath Hammond?

Captain Asenath Hammond was a Starfleet officer in the 24th century.

In 2364, she was the commander of the . Sometime in that year, she received an order about revised mission orders from Commodore Joshua Jae of Starfleet Mission Operations Division. (, okudagram)
